title_zh: 了解河轮出发与订金要求后先索取条款

scenario.label_zh: 核对河轮行程与订金后索取条款
scenario.goal_zh: 了解出发安排与交通限制并请求书面条款后再决定预订

context_zh: 旅客克拉拉向虚构旅行社询问河轮旅行；报价与条件仅用于语言练习。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: I'm interested in the four-night river cruise. When does the boat depart?

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: At five on Monday afternoon. Passengers need to be on board by four.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: My domestic flight arrives at three. That sounds too close.

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: I agree. You could arrive the previous day, but you'd need to arrange that separately.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: Can passengers sit outside on the deck?

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: Yes, when it's open. There's an indoor lounge as well.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: How much is the deposit, and what happens if I cancel?

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: The deposit is a hundred pounds per person. The refund conditions depend on when you cancel, so I'll send the full terms rather than summarize them from memory.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: Please do. I'll check the flights and read the terms before deciding whether to book.

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: Certainly. Nothing has been reserved or charged.

targets.sense_zh: 乘船度假或游览的旅行
